items.title: The decision is in the model before it emits a letter; read it there.
items.meta: Contextual readout keeps knowledge with a quarter of the letter interface's order fragility · §3l, §3v

items.title: Two artifacts caused the evidence-vs-knowledge trade-off: last-layer taps and a rendered “none of the above” line.
items.meta: Removing both: JevBench .694 with no workflow training · §3r, §3t

items.title: Rubric-conditioned workflow data teaches the decision shapes it contains, not the general abstraction.
The training mix is a first-class variable; one global null threshold cannot serve evidence and workflow sets.
items.meta: E .45–.50 restores evidence; ∅-augmented rows fix abstention · §3y–§3aa

items.title: Small batches under-fit: better hard-tier numbers at the cost of everything in-distribution.
items.meta: The 1.7B hard tier is a probability-quality problem · §3aa

items.title: Ordinal-smoothed Score fixes calibration with zero decision changes; a Bernoulli Noul head is exactly order-invariant.
DecisionMix v2 transfers within its rule grammar and not beyond it.
items.meta: Families +34–37, flip .48 → .71; level-7 composition at chance for every model · §3ad

items.title: 1.7B → 4B → 14B lifts standard accuracy and knowledge; long states and soft calibration do not scale.
items.meta: JevBench .750 → .833 → .875 at 45 → 56 → 60 ms; frozen 14B 3-shot beats trained on hard · §3ab
